about_the_game:
NEON DIGITAL

BEND REALITY. MASTER PORTALS. DOMINATE THE ARENA.

Enter the electrifying world of Neon Digital, where portal manipulation transforms traditional arena combat in adrenaline-fueled 3v3 matches. In this fast-paced tactical shooter, victory demands both lightning reflexes and strategic mastery of portal mechanics.

REVOLUTIONARY PORTAL MECHANICS

Deploy portals with pinpoint precision to create impossible angles, curve grenades through reality, and access areas your opponents thought were safe. Place portals at long range for tactical advantages or up close for devastating surprise attacks. Every surface is an opportunity to redefine the battlefield.

ADVANCED PORTAL STRATEGIES

Outthink and outmaneuver your opponents with creative portal placement. Set up complex chains of portals to send projectiles on unpredictable paths or create instant escape routes when under pressure. The most cunning portal strategists will always stay one step ahead.

MULTIPLE PATHS TO VICTORY

Adapt your strategy to secure victory through different objectives:

  • Score in the opponent's net with skillful portal play

  • Control strategic objective points on the arena floor

  • Eliminate the entire enemy team with calculated precision

DYNAMIC 3V3 TEAM GAMEPLAY

Coordinate with teammates to execute complex strategies or improvise in the heat of battle. Different player roles ensure every match brings fresh tactical challenges and opportunities for creative portal use.

MASTER THE CHAOS

Neon Digital rewards creativity and quick thinking. The most successful players will combine strategic portal placement and team coordination to dominate the arena in style.

Join the competition today and discover why players call Neon Digital the most innovative arena shooter of the year!

content_descriptors.notes: Each player has space augmented guns that they can use to fire at other players while fighting in an arena over control points on the map.

  • Storage: 5 GB available space

Win by scoring in the net, controlling objective points, or eliminating the enemy team. Master portal tactics to dominate the arena.
